options.content:
## Are we on track?

Lumen Supply's revenue against plan. Revenue is completed orders net of discounts, in USD. **Click a region** in the attainment bars, the map of revenue, or the table to open its detail. The question to answer: which region missed its target last quarter, and why?

query.sql: SELECT sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM monthly_kpis WHERE month >= (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) - interval '3 months' AND month < (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis)

SELECT 100.0 * sum(revenue) / sum(revenue_target) AS attainment FROM monthly_kpis WHERE month >= (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) - interval '3 months' AND month < (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis)

SELECT sum(orders) AS orders FROM monthly_kpis WHERE month >= (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) - interval '3 months' AND month < (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis)
SELECT month, sum(active_customers) AS customers FROM monthly_kpis GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

panels.title: Attainment by region, last full quarter
panels.description: Click a region to open its detail.

query.sql: SELECT region, 100.0 * sum(revenue) / sum(revenue_target) AS attainment FROM monthly_kpis WHERE month >= (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) - interval '3 months' AND month < (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) GROUP BY region ORDER BY attainment

panels.title: Revenue vs. target by month (USD)
panels.description: Full months only. The current month is left out until it ends.

query.sql: SELECT to_char(month, 'Mon YYYY') AS month, sum(revenue) AS revenue, sum(revenue_target) AS target FROM monthly_kpis WHERE month < (SELECT max(month) FROM monthly_kpis) GROUP BY monthly_kpis.month ORDER BY monthly_kpis.month

panels.title: Last quarter's revenue by region and channel
panels.description: Each region's share, split by channel. Click a region to open its detail.

query.sql: SELECT region, channel, sum(revenue) AS revenue FROM daily_revenue WHERE order_date >= (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) - interval '3 months' AND order_date < (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) GROUP BY region, channel

panels.title: Regions, last full quarter
panels.description: Each row links to the region's detail.

query.sql: SELECT region, sum(revenue) AS revenue, sum(revenue_target) AS target, 100.0 * sum(revenue) / sum(revenue_target) AS attainment, sum(orders) AS orders FROM monthly_kpis WHERE month >= (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) - interval '3 months' AND month < (SELECT date_trunc('quarter', max(month)) FROM monthly_kpis) GROUP BY region ORDER BY attainment

panels.title: Store error rate, last hour
panels.description: From the live service metrics. Open the service health dashboard from this panel's menu.

query.sql: SELECT time_bucket('1 minute', ts) AS minute, 100.0 * sum(errors) / nullif(sum(requests), 0) AS error_pct FROM request_metrics GROUP BY minute ORDER BY minute
